question: Which of the following BEST explains why the Caribbean needs to reduce dependence on imported food?
options: To improve food security, save foreign exchange and protect communities from global price shocks
Because imported food is always unhealthy
Because the Caribbean produces no food at all
None of the above

question: Which of the following describes the impact of the brain drain on Caribbean countries?
options: Educated and skilled people leave reducing the human capital available for national development
It has no impact on the countries they leave
It only affects small islands
None of the above

question: Which of the following is a way in which the Caribbean diaspora contributes to development?
options: Sending remittances, investing in businesses and sharing skills and knowledge with their home countries
Only by returning home permanently
Only by sending money occasionally
None of the above

question: A bar chart shows that banana exports fell from 2010 to 2020. What is the MOST LIKELY cause?
options: Competition from cheaper bananas from other regions and impact of storms on crops
Vincentians stopped liking bananas
The government banned banana farming
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes the blue economy concept for the Caribbean?
options: Sustainable use of ocean resources including fisheries, shipping and marine tourism for economic growth
An economy that only uses the colour blue
Only about fishing
None of the above

question: Which of the following is an example of how SVG's geography affects its economy?
options: Mountainous terrain limits large-scale farming but supports eco-tourism and niche agriculture like arrowroot
The flat terrain makes large-scale farming easy everywhere
SVG has no natural features of economic value

question: Which of the following BEST describes what food security means?
options: When all people have reliable access to enough nutritious food to lead healthy lives
When a country grows all its own food
When food is locked away safely
None of the above

question: Which of the following is a challenge that small island developing states like SVG face?
options: Limited resources, vulnerability to natural disasters and climate change and dependence on a few industries
No challenges compared to larger countries
Only economic challenges
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes how cooperation among Caribbean nations helps during a disaster?
options: Countries share resources, personnel and expertise because no small island can manage a major disaster alone
Each country must always manage disasters alone

question: Which of the following describes the impact of plastic pollution on Caribbean marine life?
options: Marine animals ingest or get entangled in plastic causing injury and death and damaging entire ecosystems
Plastic pollution only affects beaches not marine life
Marine life is unaffected by plastic pollution

question: Which of the following BEST describes the role of civic education in Caribbean schools?

Only teaching history
Only preparing students for elections when they are adults

question: Which of the following is an example of how technology has improved life in Caribbean communities?

question: Which of the following BEST explains why Caribbean countries promote cultural festivals internationally?
options: To attract tourists, earn foreign exchange and share Caribbean culture and identity with the world
Only to entertain locals

question: Which of the following is a way in which poor sanitation affects community health?
options: It spreads waterborne diseases like cholera especially affecting children and vulnerable community members
It has no health impacts

question: Which of the following BEST describes what sustainable agriculture means?
options: Farming in ways that maintain soil health, protect the environment and can continue productively for future generations
